title: Kneaded Yeasty French Cheese Blanquette
description: A yeasty, cheese-pull French dish featuring plain chocolate, this blanquette is a unique and adventurous option for dinner. It is jain-friendly and features an ice-bath-shock step.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add sugar, soy milk, and melted butter to the bowl and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a large rectangle.
Sprinkle shredded gruyere cheese and plain chocolate chips over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a blanquette shape and press the edges to seal.
Place the blanquette in an ice bath for 10 minutes to shock the yeast.
Remove the blanquette from the ice bath and let it rise for another 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees and bake the blanquette for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
